description: This PHP source file defines the NormalizerService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to normalize data objects and arrays, leveraging a trait for shared normalization logic. It is part of the Core Service layer, facilitating data serialization and transformation.

classes.name: NormalizerService
classes.description: A service class responsible for normalizing data objects and arrays, utilizing a trait for actual normalization implementation.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a single data object or scalar data based on the specified model class.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an array of data objects based on the specified model class.
